definition: An imaginary line about which an object rotates; Earth’s axis intersects the surface at its geographic poles.
intuition: Think of a spinning globe rotating around a rod through its center. The axis stays approximately fixed relative to the distant stars during a day.
misconceptions: An axis is a geometric line, not a physical rod.
takeaway: The axis determines the directions of the celestial poles.

source.section: Looking Out from a Spinning, Round Earth
